text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful run! Win Variation!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Led by Orfevre, there are so many
eye-catching Umamusume this year.
Next year's Classic campaign will certainly be exciting.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Somehow, I saw it through to the end...!
choice_data_list: Good work, that was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you so much.
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because you gave me so much training,
I felt like I was able to do my best in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Running today really drove it home, though.
If I'm gonna take on Orfe-san from here on out, I'm still nowhere near ready."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She's... extraordinary.
She's in a place ordinary effort can't reach.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to try
even harder to make up for it...!
choice_data_list: You really are such a hard worker, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I first met her,
she was training with everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her push forward so desperately was so captivating that I couldn't help but call out, "Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Y-You think so? I'm just doing it because I'm not good enough yet, so—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, but, um...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...My dad is an incredibly hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She's like that now, but apparently there was a time
back then when the spotlight hardly shone on her at all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ever since my trainee days, I had this ultimate rival.
No matter how hard I tried, I could never shine brighter than him.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, even during those times, I kept working hard without giving up.
After lessons were over, I'd practice on my own late into the night at a park with big glass windows.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"As I kept living those days on and on,
before I knew it, I was standing in the center of the stage—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
They say she stood in the spotlight.
And that's how... she seized the role of the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's why.
It makes me feel like I gotta give it my all if I wanna make my dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Effort will never betray you.
Someday, it will surely pay off.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: So I'll try and try my best, and then someday, somewhere—surely.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I can surpass Orfevre and become the main star.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I can really believe that.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
Whoa, I'm sorry, I went on a whole rant there!"
choice_data_list: No, I'm just glad I got to know more about you, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, letting her thoughts wander,
her burning desire to beat Orfevre
came through with painful clarity.
choice_data_list: (I want to make sure she wins no matter what...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, what should be done right now to make that dream come true? After racking my brains all night—the next day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So for a while, we won't set a target race
and just focus on training... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I give a small nod.
If I am to make her dream come true no matter what,
I feel that cautious preparation is above all necessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if we were to confront Orfevre at this stage,
it's unlikely we'd obtain the desired result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then it'd be best to focus on training
and polish herself further to prepare for the upcoming Classic tier.
That is what I told her."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. If that is what you say, Trainer, then I believe it is for the best."
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're fine with letting it go that easily?
Are you sure you're fine with letting it go that easily?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's what I realized after my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer laid out the path and guided my steps,
I was able to keep growing stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You really are amazing. You know so many times more things than I do...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So, if someone like you thinks that, Trainer,
I reckon that's what you oughta do.
choice_data_list: I see... Got it, thank you!
I see... Got it, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring the deep trust between us,
I immediately hand her the tablet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the screen, I laid out the target growth curve
and the target time she needed
to achieve by early February.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Reach this time by around early February...!?
With how I am right now, can I really... do it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In order to stand a chance against Orfevre, I set the bar quite high. But for her, it certainly shouldn't be impossible.
choice_data_list: It's okay, let's do our best with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You're right.
I've made it all the way here properly.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I achieve it, I'll definitely get stronger! Yeah... I'll definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was time to dive into rigorous training
in preparation for the upcoming Classic campaign!
